# American Psychiatric Association App Evaluation Model

The American Psychiatric Association's app evaluation model asks users and clinicians to consider privacy, security, evidence, usability, interoperability, and whether an app clearly describes data handling and safety responses.

For this project, the resource is relevant when explaining why a mental-health-adjacent app should be transparent about privacy, evidence, and escalation boundaries.
